briefdescription.para: Provides a stub handler for uninitialized callbacks.
Initializes the AXI XSPI driver instance.

simplesect.para:
- XST_SUCCESS if initialization was successful.
XST_DEVICE_IS_STARTED if the instance is already initialized.

briefdescription.para: Aborts the current transfer and returns the core to an idle state.

detaileddescription.para: The core has no abort control, so a software reset is the only way to tear down a transaction that is already running. It is also what the core offers for recovering from a transaction error. The reset also disables every interrupt and discards every latched event, so nothing the abandoned transfer raised is left behind.
The core is enabled again on return, and the clock mode and selected target are put back. So the caller can start a new transfer without any further setup.

briefdescription.para: Performs one or more transfers in polled (blocking) mode.

detaileddescription.para: Each message describes a Lite-mode transaction (command/address plus one data phase). Messages are dispatched to the existing polled engine (AmdXspi_LiteRead / AmdXspi_LiteWrite) in order and the function returns when all messages complete or on the first failure.

parameterdescription.para: Number of messages in the array.

simplesect.para:
- XST_SUCCESS if all messages transferred.
XST_DEVICE_BUSY if a transfer is already in progress.
XST_FAILURE if a transfer failed.

briefdescription.para: Initiates an interrupt-driven transfer of one or more messages.

detaileddescription.para: This function is non-blocking: it launches the first message and returns immediately. The interrupt handler (AmdXspi_InterruptHandler) drains receive data and advances through the message queue. When all messages complete, it invokes the status handler registered with AmdXspi_SetStatusHandler with XST_SPI_TRANSFER_DONE (or a non-zero error event on failure).

parameterdescription.para: Number of messages in the array.

simplesect.para:
- XST_SUCCESS if the transfer was started.
XST_DEVICE_BUSY if a transfer is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Serves as the main interrupt handler for the AXI XSPI controller.

detaileddescription.para: This function reads the interrupt status, clears the pending interrupts, and advances the active message queue, reporting the outcome through the handler registered with AmdXspi_SetStatusHandler().
Receive data is drained both on RX fill-level events and at transaction completion. So a read is not limited to what the RX FIFO holds at the end of the transaction.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the AmdXspi instance (cast to void*).

briefdescription.para: Sets the status callback of the message-based AmdXspi_InterruptTransfer().

detaileddescription.para: The handler is invoked from interrupt context with XST_SPI_TRANSFER_DONE when the whole message queue completes. It is invoked with a non-zero error event mask if the transfer fails.

parameterdescription.para: Reference passed back to the handler.

briefdescription.para: Implements the application-facing APIs of the AXI XSPI driver.

detaileddescription.para: This file contains the implementation of the application facing APIs of the AXI XSPI driver, including the interrupt handler. This driver supports AXI-Lite mode only. Supplying it a design built in any other mode is a configuration error the driver does not check for.
